subject: Request: PO number + spend-cap assignment / line-item correction
messages:
From: Lisa Hammond <lisa.hammond@bayshore-analytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO info and line items

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to move forward with Redwood for inference credits and a small dedicated capacity pilot. Procurement asked me to capture a few details so they can issue the PO:

- Company legal name: Bayshore Analytics, Inc.
- Billing contact: Tom Ruiz (tom.ruiz@bayshore-analytics.com)
- Estimated monthly spend: $18k (first quarter)
- Desired spend cap: $25,000 monthly

I've attached our completed onboarding form and an initial line-item spreadsheet (bayshore_lineitems_v2.xlsx). Procurement also asked if Redwood can provide an initial PO number they can reference while our internal PO is routed — that helps lock the pricing and billing account.

Can you confirm next steps and whether you need anything else from me to start a provisional PO?

Thanks,
Lisa Hammond
Senior Vendor Ops
Bayshore Analytics
Attachments: Bayshore_onboarding_form_v1.pdf, bayshore_lineitems_v2.xlsx
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Hammond <lisa.hammond@bayshore-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO info and line items

Hi Lisa — thanks, received the form and spreadsheet. Looping in procurement and finance to assign a provisional PO number and confirm spend-cap handling.

Karthik / Marcus — Bayshore is requesting: provisional PO number for reference, a spend-cap set to $25k/mo, and an initial line-item mapping based on the attached file. They noted billing contact is Tom Ruiz.

Quick asks:
- Karthik: can you create a provisional PO ticket and advise whether the $25k spend cap requires an approval cadence or can be set at onboarding?
- Marcus: can you review the line items and let us know if any SKU remapping is needed before issuing a PO?

Lisa — I will track progress here and share the provisional PO number once procurement issues it.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Revenue
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Hammond <lisa.hammond@bayshore-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO info and line items

Ava — thanks for the context. I've opened a provisional PO ticket: PO-8421 (provisional) and attached the provisional ticket stub for internal tracking (PO-8421_provisional_ticket.pdf).

Notes from procurement review:
- Provisional PO issued to allow billing/account setup. Final official PO number will be assigned once Bayshore's internal PO is approved, but PO-8421 can be referenced in invoices in the meantime.
- Spend cap: $25,000/month is within our standard onboarding limits for pilot customers. Procurement flags anything above $30k for director approval; no extra approvals needed here.
- Line items: the attached spreadsheet has three top-level line items. Marcus — review request: the 'Inference Credits - OnDemand' SKU should be split into 'Inference Credits - Pilot (monthly)' and 'Batch Credits (on-demand)'. Please confirm quantity splits.

Action items: 
- Marcus: return with recommended splits and updated totals (ETA: EOD Mon 22 Jun).
- Ava: confirm the billing contact and whether they require invoices to reference a PO number as soon as possible.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO-8421_provisional_ticket.pdf
From: Lisa Hammond <lisa.hammond@bayshore-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO info and line items

Thanks Karthik — that's perfect. We do need a provisional PO referenced on any early invoices. On the line items, Tom reviewed and asked to change the product code for 'Batch Credits' to 'BATCH-CR-STD' (they use that across their finance system). I've attached an updated line-item sheet with the code swap and a small quantity tweak (bayshore_lineitems_v2.xlsx — updated tab "rev1").

If Marcus can incorporate the code change and update totals against PO-8421, we can route our internal PO faster. Let me know if you need a formal vendor packet from our side.

Best,
Lisa
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Lisa Hammond <lisa.hammond@bayshore-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO info and line items

All — updated the mapping and totals and finalized the provisional PO reference. Summary below and attached updated sheet (bayshore_lineitems_v2_final.xlsx):

- Provisional PO: PO-8421 (reference only until Bayshore issues official PO)
- Spend cap: set to $25,000/month (procurement note saved)
- Line-item adjustments applied:
  * Inference Credits - Pilot (monthly): 800 units @ $15/unit = $12,000
  * Batch Credits (BATCH-CR-STD): 60 units @ $100/unit = $6,000
  * Integration & Onboarding services (one-time): $6,500
  => Provisional total: $24,500/month first month including one-time services

Next steps: Ava, please confirm with Bayshore billing contact that invoices referencing PO-8421 are acceptable. Lisa — once your internal PO is in the system, reply here and we will swap the provisional reference for the official PO number on invoices going forward.

Attachments: bayshore_lineitems_v2_final.xlsx

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
